create_CLIP_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance to tokenize text strings into CLIP token IDs with BPE encoding
tokenize_text_with_SimpleTokenizer: tokenize a list of text strings into a torch tensor of shape [batch, 77] using SimpleTokenizer
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of token IDs back into human-readable text using SimpleTokenizer.decode
canonicalize_text: canonicalize text by removing punctuation, lowercasing, and collapsing whitespace using canonicalize_text
mask_tokenize_with_reduction: tokenize texts exceeding context length by randomly masking tokens using simple_mask_tokenize or random_mask_tokenize
